caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned horizontally in the center of the image, which is a rolling pin. The rolling pin consists of a cylindrical middle section and two tapered, rounded handles on either end. The central cylinder has a slightly textured surface with visible grain patterns, indicating it is made of wood. The handles are smoother with a gentle curve, and each ends in a rounded knob. The color palette of the drawing is monochromatic, utilizing shades of gray and black to illustrate texture, depth, and shadow. The background is plain and light in color, offering no additional objects or patterns. There is a small, handwritten label in the bottom left corner of the drawing, but it is not prominent in the composition.
title: Rolling Pin
